limitations: Historical bad ACK has a valid complete IrLAP FCS but no complete API arrival trace; this investigation did not identify its complete cause.
Successful instrumented replay does not establish asynchronous browser reliability or physical timing.
Changed WASM host performance may alter browser pacing, even where guest semantics are equal for the same API trace.
No production core or guest input semantics were changed during this investigation.

final_frontend_component_scope.source_scope: Integrated root working-tree sources; each component driver bundles its fixture from the production modules. Production dist was not rebuilt or modified by these tests.
final_frontend_component_scope.scope: Chromium component, storage and maintained host-bridge regressions. Held-key lifecycle fixtures use real DOM events and capture with explicitly dispatched lifecycle events and synthetic Worker snapshots. Original-ROM game acceptance is recorded separately.

retained_irda_counterexample.observed_failure: Both original calculators report SEND/RECV Timeout during the reverse IrLAP connection attempt; neither direction has a reverse Kermit file packet.
retained_irda_counterexample.scope: Retained failed final-frontend attempt, not a completed bidirectional acceptance run. Subsequent deterministic investigation is recorded separately.

ci_async_request_regression.cause: The multipart upload test matched a previous hp39-wire receive request before async File.arrayBuffer preflight posted the new LIB upload.
ci_async_request_regression.controlled_regression: Hold the first real file read behind an explicit latch, confirm that only the stale receive exists, release the read, require one new request, and assert LIB/send/hp39-wire/usb and every original library byte.

node_fixed_workloads.measurement: Node/V8 execution from exact private scene checkpoints to the baseline first full LCD result, including all key releases and their final gap. Each variant executes the complete workload twice before alternating timed replays; the first baseline replay locates the result. Loading, explicit WASM compilation, restore, LCD sampling and final checkpoint hashing are outside timed intervals. JS key scheduling, UART draining and incremental UART hashing are included. This is host execution throughput, not browser latency or real-calculator calibration.
node_fixed_workloads.checkpoint_comparison: Validate each wire checksum and exact schema layout, apply the documented legacy migrations, and compare every canonical byte, including v7 architectural TLB entries and replacement state, CPU, devices and memories. Host lookup hints are excluded by the checkpoint format itself. Raw wire hashes are retained separately.

chrome_worker_fixed_workloads.measurement: Two complete warmups per variant, then four alternating AB/BA timed replays per scene. Production WASM executes in a dedicated WebWorker under default Chrome with no V8 flags. Loading, explicit compilation, restore, LCD inspection and hashes are outside timing. Key scheduling and UART draining/byte capture are inside; WebCrypto UART hashing is outside. No Worker pacing, UI input, snapshot delivery or canvas rendering is timed.
